digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review-bot authentication and token management
propositions: The GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext by the review-bot when sourced from the URL query string (?token=) in uvicorn access logs, creating a credential exposure.
Code fix 66af moved token sourcing from query string to X-Rebar-Token header and added TokenRedactingFilter redaction, but was not yet deployed to the prod container before rotation was attempted.

GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret simultaneously used as the bot's Gerrit HTTP basic-auth password, the inbound webhook authentication secret, and a container environment variable, requiring coordinated rotation across all three channels via service-user.sh.
The compromised token must not be rotated until the 66af code fix is deployed to prod, otherwise the new token will be re-logged in plaintext on the next webhook call.

Rotation requires a three-step sequence: deploy 66af to prod, rotate the token via service-user.sh (updating Gerrit password, SSM parameter, and webhooks.config), and restart the review-bot container to load the new credential.
